def snap(f):
    seg=f.segmentation; out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        r0=min(rows)
        if r0<50:
            if n['pixels']==16: out.append('%s r%d c%d'%(n['color'],r0,min(cols)))
            elif n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18: out.append('P r%d'%r0)
            elif n['color']=='w' and n['pixels']>=4: out.append('B c%d-%d'%(min(cols),max(cols)))
